title: The natural voice (Phonon) downloads, loads and speaks

steps.js: const t0 = Date.now(); const e = await Phonon.load(); return { ok: !!e, s: Math.round((Date.now() - t0) / 1000), build: Phonon.buildKey() }
steps.why: Download and load the natural voice

steps.js: const eng = await Phonon.load(), t0 = performance.now(); let n = 0, first = 0; await eng.speak('MuseTester is checking the natural voice.', Phonon.voiceId(), pcm => { first ||= performance.now() - t0; n += pcm.length; }).done; return { seconds: +(n / 24000).toFixed(2), firstMs: Math.round(first), speed: +((performance.now() - t0) / 1000 / (n / 24000)).toFixed(2) }
steps.why: Make a line of speech (as Settings › Voice › Test does)
It made over a second of speech
…fast enough to keep up (under 1.5× the time it takes to say)
